notes.title: New Update X New Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Whispering Memories – Demo Update Now Live! 🎉

We're excited to roll out the first update to the Whispering Memories demo, bringing quality-of-life improvements, minor fixes, and a few enhancements that smooth out the gameplay experience for both new and returning players.

📝 Here’s what’s new in this update:

 Reworked Chapter 3 (Bedroom at Night) dialogue to better connect with the upcoming Chapter 4 storyline.
 Added 'Click to Continue' image at the end of dialogues for clarity.
 Character sprites now show as focused/unfocused, depending on who’s speaking.
 You can now click the SMS screen to speed up message delivery.
 Message flow has been reversed to go from top to bottom, like any modern chat app.
 Pressing ESC or Right-Click now opens the Quick Phone Menu instead of the main menu.
 Fixed 'Key-chain' achievements being triggered at the end instead of when found.
 Quick Load now includes a confirmation window to prevent accidental overwrites.
 Minor script cleanups and sound tweaks.

🎬 NEW TRAILER OUT NOW!
Catch a glimpse of actual gameplay and the mysterious atmosphere of Starvale in our brand-new trailer:
[previewyoutube=up5qQ0UL1kQ;full][/previewyoutube]

🌟 Thank you all for the incredible feedback so far — and for helping Whispering Memories reach a Positive Rating on Steam! Your support means everything.

If you haven't yet, be sure to try the demo, leave a review, and wishlist the full game to stay in the loop.

More to come soon — see you in Starvale. 🚂
